piece.caption: Free 3D CAD modeling software for interior contractors and furniture makers. If you plan cabinets, tables, or workshop layout projects, you do not need paid software subscriptions. KetchUp is an open-source 3D modeling web app built with Rust and WebGPU. It runs directly inside your desktop browser without creating an account. You can draw outlines, use Push/Pull to build 3D geometry, inspect with dimensions, import SketchUp (.skp) geometry, and export OBJ files. Remember that browser data clearing deletes autosaved work, so download your .ketchup project files locally. Comment KETCHUP for the direct link and user guide.

claims.claim: KetchUp is a free, open-source 3D modeling app for woodworking and furniture design.
KetchUp runs in a desktop browser using WebGPU/WebGL2 or as native apps on Windows, macOS, and Linux without needing an account.
Users can draw shapes, use Push/Pull to convert faces into 3D forms, set exact lengths, and inspect dimensions.
KetchUp supports importing SketchUp (.skp) geometry and exporting Wavefront OBJ (.obj) files.
Work is autosaved locally in the browser, but clearing browser data can remove autosaved work since there is no cloud storage.
SketchUp textures, scenes, and some model features are not supported on import.

piece.dm_text: Here is the details for KetchUp - Free 3D Woodworking & Furniture Design App: Website URL: https://ketchup3d.github.io/app/ How to use it: 1. Open the website in a desktop browser with WebGPU hardware acceleration. No login needed. 2. Draw 2D outlines, then use Push/Pull to create 3D boards, cabinets, or furniture. 3. Enter exact lengths, snap to axes, and organize parts using groups and tags. 4. Go to File -> Import/Export to load SketchUp (.skp) geometry or export OBJ (.obj) files. Note: Textures are not imported. 5. Crucial step: Download your project file via File -> Save (.ketchup) to prevent data loss if browser cache gets cleared.

[20] Hacker News — KetchUp – Open-source SketchUp alternative built with Rust and WebGPU
URL: https://ketchup3d.github.io/app/
KetchUp — Free 3D Woodworking & Furniture Design App Skip to content 3D design for your next woodworking project. KetchUp is a free, open-source 3D modeling app for woodworking and furniture design. Plan a shelf, table, cabinet, or workbench with exact measurements before you build. Use it on Windows, macOS, Linux, or right in your desktop browser.
Download for Windows ↓ Windows x64 · .exe installer Download for macOS ↓ Apple Silicon · .pkg installer Download for Linux ↓ Linux x64 · AppImage Release notes & all downloads ↗
Free & open source. No account needed. Made for a desktop browser and a mouse.
From the first line to the finer details.
Start with a simple shape. Keep the tools you need close, and your model at the center.
Sketch lines, rectangles, circles, and freehand outlines. Turn faces into forms with Push/Pull, then move, scale, offset, and paint.
Snap to geometry and axes, type exact lengths, and add dimensions. Organize the bigger picture with groups, components, and tags.
Autosave locally and download portable .ketchup projects. Import SketchUp geometry or export an OBJ to take your model further.
Plan your furniture before the first cut.
For woodworkers, furniture makers, and DIY builders who want to explore a project in 3D.
Draw board outlines with rectangles and lines, then use Push/Pull to give them thickness. Move and copy geometry to explore shelves, tables, cabinets, workbenches, and other furniture.
Enter exact lengths, snap to geometry and axes, and use Tape Measure and Dimensions to inspect your design. Orbit around the assembly to review proportions before taking it to the workshop.
Use groups, reusable components, and tags to organize parts. Save a portable .ketchup project locally, import SketchUp geometry, or export OBJ geometry for another 3D workflow.
Start with the browser editor or download the desktop app . Read the user guide for modeling instructions and supported workflows.
The editor opens with a clean slate. Here’s a good place to start.
Click one corner, then the opposite corner to create your first face.
Choose Push/Pull, click the face, move your mouse, and click to finish.
Choose Orbit and drag to look around. Scroll to zoom; press F to fit your model.
A desktop browser with hardware acceleration and WebGPU or WebGL2 support. Use a mouse and keyboard for modeling. You can also run KetchUp as a native Windows, macOS, or Linux app.
Your model is autosaved in this browser on this device. Use File → Save to download a .ketchup project you can keep or open again. Clearing browser data can remove autosaved work, so download projects you want to keep. There’s no cloud storage or account to set up.
Use File → Import/Export to import SketchUp (.skp) geometry or export Wavefront OBJ (.obj). Imports run locally. SketchUp textures, scenes, and some model features aren’t supported; OBJ export includes geometry without materials.
Yes. KetchUp is open source under the MIT license and written in Rust. Explore the code, read the full guide, or contribute on GitHub.
